translationRepairs: An edict displayed the Yellow Gate confessor's testimony to the excellencies and ministers, dispatched the Marquis of Dongwu Sima Dan with a thousand troops to guard the Heir Apparent, confined him at the Xuchang palace, ordered the Attendant Secretary with credentials Liu Zhen to hold him under guard, and decreed that palace officials might not take leave to escort him.

An edict displayed the Yellow Gate confessor's testimony to the excellencies and ministers, dispatched the Duke of Dongwu Sima Dan with a thousand troops to guard the Heir Apparent, confined him at the Xuchang palace, ordered the Attendant Secretary with credentials Liu Zhen to hold him under guard, and decreed that palace officials might not take leave to escort him.

東武公澹 explicitly names Dan as Duke of Dongwu; 公 is duke, not marquis. This is the same named escort as the already reviewed s0194 Dongwu-title episode. Correct the repeated title in both fields, retaining all Chinese, troop numbers, offices, names and actions. The complete chapter-specific Dan/Dongwu/Chewu title search finds only these two source units.
